About this Event

DESI NIGHT RETURNS ✨We’re bringing Desi Night back to El Don for another Friday night filled with music, cocktails, dancing and late-night energy.
Join us Friday, October 16th from 7PM–11PM with sounds by DJ AP and hosted by Junior Dhaliwal.
Expect a high-energy mix of Bollywood, Punjabi, Bhangra and Desi favorites, blended with the sounds that keep the party moving all night.
And with October in full swing, El Don will have a little extra atmosphere waiting for you. 🍂🕯️ Expect our seasonal décor and limited Halloween cocktail collection throughout the restaurant — subtle spooky-season touches with the upscale El Don feel.
